description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Cookie class, which models an HTTP cookie with properties such as name, value, domain, path, expiry, and security. It includes methods for creating, validating, and serializing cookies, as well as matching cookies against URIs.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Cookie
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP cookie with properties and methods for validation, serialization, and matching against URIs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new cookie with specified parameters, with validation for name and domain.

methods.name: getExpiryTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry timestamp or null if not set.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is marked as secure.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired based on current time.

methods.name: isSessionCookie
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a session cookie (no expiry).

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if the cookie should be sent for a given URI, considering security, expiry, domain, and path.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cookie as a string suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a new Zend_Http_Cookie object from a cookie string, with optional reference URI for default domain and path.
